title: defs.v1
description: Shared types for every contract (spec 5.1, 5.3, 6.1, 6.3). Not a message: message schemas $ref these with a relative path, e.g. ../../common/defs.v1.schema.json#/$defs/Amount. Only additive changes within v1.

SchemaVersion.description: Major version of a message schema, mirrored in the mw-schema-version header (spec 6.1). Each message schema pins it with const.

TxnId.description: UUIDv7, lower case, minted by the middleware at first contact (spec 5.1).

CorrelationId.description: Propagated across all hops (X-Correlation-Id, Kafka header mw-correlation-id).

IdempotencyKey.description: From the channel (Idempotency-Key header) or derived (spec 7.3).

CommandId.description: txnId + step + attempt-independent suffix (spec 7.3); the core is idempotent on it.

Amount.description: Money on the wire: integer minor units (poisha), never a decimal (spec 5.1).

Charge.description: A charge on a transaction (FRS 2.2): fee, VAT or commission, in the same integer minor units as Amount. Optional on the messages that carry it; absent means not known or not applicable, not zero.

Msisdn.description: Bangladeshi mobile number, with or without the 880 country code.

Party.description: Who pays or receives (spec 5.1). Card numbers never appear; only tokens (SEC-02).

EncryptedPin.description: PIN encrypted under the mw-crypto PIN_TRANSPORT key keyId (RSA-OAEP, SHA-256; GET /auth/v1/pin-key). It travels only from a channel to mw-auth (spec 18.7, D20, D22), never on Kafka and never to the core: the core sees mw-auth's TxnAssertion instead (the core PIN scheme M11 was removed in ticket 72).

TxnAssertion.description: Transaction authorisation assertion (spec 18.7, D22): a compact JWS (ES256, mw-crypto ASSERTION_SIGN, kid <keyId>.v<n>) issued by mw-auth after the PIN check, 60 s, single use by jti, aud core; claims iss, aud, sub (walletId), jti, iat, exp, txnHash (base64url SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of {txnType, amount (valueMinor), currency, payer {type, id}, payee {type, id}, idempotencyKey, channel}), channel, authMethod PIN, deviceId?, newDevice. Not PIN material; the core checks it against mw-auth's assertion JWK Set.

TxnType.description: Spec 5.2, FRS 2.2. BALANCE (balance inquiry, ADR D26) moves no money: amount 0 and creditParty = debitParty (the customer's own wallet). NPSB_OUT (wallet to a bank account over NPSB), NPSB_IN (bank account to wallet over NPSB) and B2B_TRANSFER (business wallet to business wallet) are FRS 2.2 additions (ticket 92): mw-orchestrator refuses them with MW-VAL-010 until their flows exist.
